description: OHLCV candles for a token on any chain from its deepest pool, plus change, drawdown, volatility and volume computed from the candles — the only time-series data in this catalog; every other endpoint is a point-in-time snapshot. Costs $0.01.

chain.description: Optional chain id (base, ethereum, bsc, tron, sui, ...) when the same address exists on several chains; default auto-detect. Full list: https://saylorinnovations.com/api/watchdog/chains

mint.description: Token address on any supported chain: Solana mint (base58), EVM 0x address, Tron, TON, or Sui/Aptos coin type.

name: get_price_history
title: Token price history (OHLCV)
